title: 2025 JFK files release and Trump's answer on who killed Kennedy
summary: Jesse Michels tells of 2025 JFK files release and Trump's answer on who killed Kennedy, about 2025 at Washington, D.C., and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: And even President Trump when he was asked point blank who killed JFK after the file drop he said we released the files we did a historic thing or whatever.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, talks about the 2025 release of government files on the killing of President John F. Kennedy. He says that when President Donald Trump was asked directly who killed Kennedy, Trump only said they had released the files and done something historic, and Michels also mentions the commentator Bret Weinstein. To Michels, the answer suggests the full truth is still not out.
